# P36.42a — entity pages A template + organizations hub (manifest row 383)

## What this lands

The first `/entity/` routes — K2 GX-06a: the `/entity/` Organizations hub and
the 06a entity-page template for organization, agency and registry-portal
entities, rendering the P36.41 `sig.entity-page/1` + `sig.entity-label/1`
contracts end-to-end.

- **`/entity/` hub (SIG-UI-070/UXR-20)** — published entity types with counts
  as `<Figure>` (pointer into the label stream), the entity-resolution
  disclosure verbatim beside every count, and links to each type's paginated
  A–Z list; the A-10 typed `not_yet_reviewed` rows render as typed states,
  never names.
- **`/entity/<type>/` + `page/<n>/`** — the per-type A–Z lists (100/page),
  ER disclosure on the page, typed review section.
- **`/entity/<type>/<slug>--<hash>/`** — the 06a template: header (label,
  basis, review status), summary (numbers via `<Figure>` into the twin),
  Identifiers block, "What SIG records" claim groups (four epistemic fields
  separate), one relationship table per relation × direction × access kind
  with the H-2 fields (historical/undated marked, never present-tense),
  degree-only facts as sentences (never edges), contract-B typed empty
  sections, downloads (per-compartment JSON twin), cite, technical details,
  and the claim-provenance section — one J3 panel per named claim, so every
  relationship row reaches provenance in one action with and without
  JavaScript (SIG-UI-122).
- **`/entity/<type>/<key>/index.<comp>.json`** — the JSON twin download
  endpoint, emitting the same `sig.entity-page/1` bytes the page renders.

Decision lines carried verbatim: `D-K2-1 [A-10] = b + c` (published pages
only for registry auto-allowed organisations; every other organisation is a
typed `not_yet_reviewed` state); `ER_DISCLOSURE` and
`WITHHELD_RELATIONSHIPS_NOTICE` render verbatim, never re-worded;
`sig.entity-page/1` rendered, never re-shaped (contract-B sections are typed
empties under contract A).
